verdict.rationale: Morph ships an official MCP server, so agents like Claude Code can call its edit and search tools from natural-language prompts. The quickstart also has users install the Morph MCP so Claude Code can drive a migration. That is natural-language operation only through a third-party agent host; nothing shows Morph itself accepting natural-language commands to manage the product. Missing for 10: a native natural-language interface for operating or configuring Morph (endpoints, canaries, Reflexes), coverage of account and admin actions via natural language, and independent hands-on confirmation of agent-driven operation.
